entities.name: Joseph Asajirō Satowaki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Asajirô Satowaki was a Japanese prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as Archbishop of Nagasaki from 1968 to 1990, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1979.
